RECREATIONAL_PUBLIC.question: Is it legal to consume cannabis in parks, on sidewalks, or similar outdoor public spaces in the state of Connecticut?
RECREATIONAL_PUBLIC.gov_section: Cities and towns may enact ordinances to regulate whether and where cannabis can be consumed in public. At home, landlords may prohibit smoking and vaping, but they generally may not prohibit possession or consumption of other forms of cannabis. Cannabis use will be prohibited in state parks and on state beaches and waters.
